text:
The hand of the woman in love with the wind

caresses the face of the absent one.

The hallucinated woman with her "birdskin suitcase"

flees herself with a knife in memory.

She who was devoured by the mirror

enters a chest of ashes

and pacifies the beasts of oblivion.

translation.title: Caroline de Gundorode
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the poem's portrait-like sequence and its charged quotations.
